title: Simultaneous Posterior Credible Bands for Incremental-Odds Causal Curves under Soft-Tree Priors
banked_reason: D0.5.G: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope. Math panel REVISE findings remain unresolved; mathematical soundness is not established.
gap_reasons: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

Its d=1, alpha=3 early-kill calculation conflicts with epsilon_n=n^{-3/7}(log n)^11: N_n has log power 22 (not 26), while tau_*^{-1}, m, and B_* have log powers -11/3, -8/3, and -11/3 (not the displayed values).
The stated early-kill logarithmic orders are wrong: b_n and R_n have log power 23, not 27, under the core definition of epsilon_n; the polynomial early-kill conclusion remains valid after correction.

The bounded-above-and-below Lebesgue design-density clause is not consumed: approximation is uniform, and every contraction, test, and score norm is in L2(P_X); retaining it needlessly narrows the headline model.

The substantive positioning must account for every cited work—especially Linero2022SoftBart, ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2014, and vanDerVaart1998—and state at this coverage headline the precise difference from the closest posterior-band result, rather than leaving those citations without a relevance comparison.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery built a clipped-score posterior-control route and sourced the common-bandwidth approximation to Linero–Yang Lemma 1 and Appendix A. D0.5.G graded the contribution incremental, below the field floor, with no bounded in-scope lift. Math and rubric panels returned REVISE; their six findings were not repaired before triage stopped, so the concrete posterior-control, functional-BvM, and band-coverage claims are unverified. Future work would need to repair those findings and re-anchor at D-1.2 for a field-level question.
tldr: The field-level kernel is the first posterior-own-quantile simultaneous coverage theorem for a fully specified light-tailed ordinary soft-tree replacement posterior for the incremental-odds causal mean curve. Clipping posterior outcome-regression draws makes the corrected score uniformly bounded, and direct population likelihood-ratio tests yield conditional second-moment remainder \(b_n=\varepsilon_n^2\log n\). For every \(\alpha>d/2\), \(\sqrt n\,b_n\to0\), giving a functional Bernstein--von Mises theorem and exact posterior-mean-centered, posterior-standard-deviation-studentized \(95\%\) band coverage under uniform positive efficient variance and quantile regularity. This is a prospective replacement-prior result and makes no claim for the heavy-scale posterior used in the existing statin analysis.
gap: Schmidt and Wikle's available Bayesian theorem is pointwise in the odds shift, while their reported simultaneous band depends on a posterior standard-deviation curve that weak convergence alone does not control; Kennedy's valid whole-curve band uses an external multiplier distribution rather than posterior-own quantiles. Existing work also does not quantify what replaces root-\(n\) calibration at standard smoothness.
fill: The project proves the exact common-bandwidth small-ball calculation, an exponential squared-envelope posterior tail, a conditional second-moment bound of order \(b_n^2\), an honest inflated band throughout \(\alpha>d/2\), and the first exact guarded posterior-own-quantile simultaneous coverage theorem for this stated prior on the stronger \(\alpha>3d/2\) branch.
